2, 4 and 6 have no slip within 5% (counting only the trainees gives 3.4), but the evenly spaced grid is covered by the wide grid sourceHas lists and its three numeric fillers, the nearest slip falling between 2 and 4 as the note describes; strictly, the notes put a filler at the top of the grid, where this question has its answer.
